name: helianthus annuus (sunflower) seed oil
purpose: 1. Effectively resists UV rays and protects the skin from sun damage. 2. Helps maintain the youthful radiance and vitality of the skin for a long time. 3. Provides lasting moisturizing, leaving the skin hydrated and comfortable. 4. The texture is refreshing and non-greasy, and the semi-matte makeup effect is beautiful.
uses: 1. Clean your face and keep it dry. 2. Apply an appropriate amount of this product evenly on the face and body skin.
otcwarn: Discontinue use if signs of irritation or rash occur. Discontinue use if signs of irritation or rash occur. Please keep out of reach of children. Do not swallow.
